point.description: An element of the fixed carrier set under discussion.

r.description: The base edge relation whose transitive closure is discussed. The closure profile adds `tc[r](a, b)` and `rtc[r](a, b)` — the transitive and reflexive-transitive closures of a named homogeneous binary relation — with a least-fixed-point semantics over arbitrary, possibly infinite structures.

s.description: A second binary relation, assumed transitive where stated.
